answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 39931 Country: India Title: Is it an innovation to make dua in group made by imam after every prayer and also after Janaza prayer Question: Is it an innovation to make dua in group made by imam after every prayer and also after Janaza prayer? Answer ID: 39931 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1075/1075/M=1433) (1) It is not bidah. Salah is complete after imam turns his head for salam and the contact of imam and muqtadi comes to an end. If someone wants to leave he may do so. It is not wajib and necessary to join the imam in dua. But after fardh salah, duas are accepted. It is proved by the sayings and practice of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) to supplicate after salah. Also it is not bad if people do dua after salah individually while it looks like as collective dua. (2) Actually Janazah salah is a dua in the favour of deceased person; hence it is not proved to supplicate just after turning salam again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
